contract: 3.31.2 evidence-first Blu-ray edition review: dense, quiet, scannable; exact identifiers and edition facts precede Include; partial enrichment is visible and ineligible; usable at desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844.

accessibility.evidence: Playwright exercised named tabs, labeled previous/next edition controls, the labeled full-set checkbox, visible disabled and enabled Include states, keyboard-native buttons, and readable focusable source actions.

responsive.evidence: Desktop uses a restrained right-side review drawer; the 390x844 capture shows the same evidence hierarchy without horizontal overflow, clipped identifiers, or inaccessible actions.

loading.evidence: The existing stable drawer shell retains the Loading batch review message while detail is fetched.

empty.evidence: The existing no-conflicts state explains that the full set remains available for review.

error.evidence: The browser regression presents a bounded detail enrichment failure reason and disables Include with a rerun-collector recovery path.

partial.evidence: Missing cover and nullable identifiers render as explicit Not supplied/No cover states; failed detail evidence stays visible but ineligible.

success.evidence: Enriched edition evidence shows verified status, release title, format, edition, country, year, Blu-ray ID, UPC/EAN, and ASIN before Include.

permission.reason: The drawer is reachable only after the existing authenticated exact-library admin route succeeds; unauthorized access is handled by the shared application boundary rather than this component.

renderedEvidence.observation: The desktop drawer keeps collection context, edition navigation, verification state, identity fields, review controls, and Apply status in one scan path.
The narrow drawer wraps evidence into two compact columns, keeps all tabs visible, and anchors Refresh and Apply without covering review content.
